anchor-invariant-end-before-start.json.reason: embedded anchor must satisfy anchor invariants: range end must be >= start

anchor-on-edit.json.reason: edit body must not carry anchor

anchor-schema-invalid.json.reason: anchor must conform to anchor schema (missing required fields)

empty-text-create.json.reason: create body text must be non-empty

empty-text-edit.json.reason: edit body text must be non-empty

in-reply-to-on-edit.json.reason: edit body must not carry in_reply_to

invalid-in-reply-to.json.reason: in_reply_to must be printable non-space ASCII

invalid-op-type.json.reason: comment op_type must be create, edit, or delete

malformed-subject-id.json.reason: subject object_id must be printable non-space ASCII

malformed-subject-type.json.reason: subject object_type must be a valid lowercase type name

not-canonical.json.reason: bytes must be canonical JSON without formatting whitespace

self-reply.json.reason: in_reply_to must not reference the comment's own object_id

subject-on-edit.json.reason: edit body must not carry subject
